description:
⚠️ WRITE OPERATION - Confirm with user before calling. Creates a new user in your Fivetran account.

For a regular user, an invitation email is sent, and the user must accept it before gaining access; their details are accessible through the API in the meantime.

For a service account, the user gets created immediately with no invitation or email validation required.

> Note: A service account user can't create another service account user.

email.description: The email address that the user has associated with their user profile. Optional for service accounts (`user_type: SERVICE_ACCOUNT`).

family_name.description: The last name of the user.

given_name.description: The first name of the user.

phone.description: The phone number of the user.

picture.description: The user's avatar as a URL link (for example, 'http:<!-- -->//mycompany.com/avatars/john_white.png') or base64 data URI (for example, 'data:image/png;base64,aHR0cDovL215Y29tcGFueS5jb20vYXZhdGFycy9qb2huX3doaXRlLnBuZw==')

role.description: The role that you would like to assign to the user

user_type.description: The type of user. Possible values: `REGULAR_USER`: A human user who can log in to the Fivetran dashboard and interact with the API, and `SERVICE_ACCOUNT`: A non-human identity for machine-to-machine API access that cannot log in to the dashboard.

id.description: The unique identifier for the user within the Fivetran system.

email.description: The email address that the user has associated with their user profile. Optional for service accounts (`user_type: SERVICE_ACCOUNT`).

verified.description: The field indicates whether the user has verified their email address in the account creation process.

invited.description: The field indicates whether the user has been invited to your account.

picture.description: The user's avatar as a URL link (for example, 'http:<!-- -->//mycompany.com/avatars/john_white.png') or base64 data URI (for example, 'data:image/png;base64,aHR0cDovL215Y29tcGFueS5jb20vYXZhdGFycy9qb2huX3doaXRlLnBuZw==')

phone.description: The phone number of the user.

role.description: The role that you would like to assign to the user

active.description: The field indicates if the user is an active Fivetran account user.

given_name.description: The first name of the user.

family_name.description: The last name of the user.

logged_in_at.description: The last time that the user has logged into their Fivetran account.

created_at.description: The timestamp that the user created their Fivetran account

user_type.description: The type of user. Possible values: `REGULAR_USER`: A human user who can log in to the Fivetran dashboard and interact with the API, and `SERVICE_ACCOUNT`: A non-human identity for machine-to-machine API access that cannot log in to the dashboard.

has_api_key.description: Indicates whether the user has an assigned API key, including expired keys. Accepted values: `true` or `false`.
